behaviour.unbound: The board names itself and shows the configured empty message.
behaviour.empty: Same as unbound; no office columns are rendered.
behaviour.invalidRow: A row whose timeZone the platform cannot resolve still renders, showing UTC time and stating that the zone is unavailable rather than dropping the office or crashing the board.
behaviour.missingHours: Defaults to 09:00-17:00 local so an operator can add a site with only a name and a zone.
